gen-gf-sniglet-gf-mingzat: Mingzat has curvy, contemporary letters that feel unclamped, free to swell wherever a shape wants. And Sniglet above it is a display face whose diagonals carry as much heft as its stems, so the two sit comfortably apart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-molengo: Distinctive is the right word for Sniglet, whose strokes stay one uniform weight from end to end, with no thick-thin accents. And Molengo takes over below with wide gaps that keep even tiny sizes crisp, a lighter touch than the heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-momo-trust-sans: Chunky, friendly, a bit bold. Momo Trust Sans gives the pair its best quality: bowls as heavy as its stems and wide-mouthed curves that make Sniglet's display voice feel approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-national-park: Rounded and blunt, Sniglet makes a commanding entrance with terminals that stop before curling back. National Park just keeps its pen pressure steady and one side open.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya says, with a visibly gaping c at any size. But Sniglet's r, n and m, with arches matching their stems, are the louder voice, a display heading over a quieter sans-serif body.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Cut-out strokes like a fixed-width router bit give Sniglet its look. And Noto Sans Hatran answers with a wide, funnel-like throat in the e, which makes a lighter, more approachable counterpart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Sniglet draws every character with a marker-like plainness, distinctive and a little commanding. And Noto Sans Javanese, a sans-serif, keeps its counters connected to the space outside, so the two sit together lightly on the page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Marker-plain and blunt. Sniglet has no stroke contrast at all, and Noto Sans Kawi's open-jawed c, like a pair of pliers, gives the sans-serif body a lighter, cleaner bite beneath it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Sniglet leads with a blunt, round-tip marker feel from end to end, and terminals that stop before curling back. But Noto Sans Linear A, a sans-serif, brings the pair its quiet strength with a visibly gaping c at any size.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Crossbars as thick as the stems give Sniglet a blunt, distinctive build. Noto Sans Manichaean, a sans-serif, brings the pair its modern, clean quality with e crossbars that have open mouths.
